toDouble.returns: The number, or 0 if the text does not start with a number.

c_str.summary: Gives the text as a plain C character array, for functions that need const char *.
c_str.returns: Pointer to the characters; valid until the String changes.

reserve.summary: Sets aside memory in advance so the String can grow without fragmenting RAM.

params.size: Number of characters to make room for.

reserve.returns: true if the memory was available.

getBytes.summary: Copies the characters into a byte array, ending with a 0 byte.

params.bufsize: Size of the array, including room for the ending 0.
params.index: Position in the String to start copying from (default 0).

toCharArray.summary: Copies the characters into a char array, ending with a 0 character.

params.bufsize: Size of the array, including room for the ending 0.
params.index: Position in the String to start copying from (default 0).

TwoWire.summary: The I2C bus class. You do not create it yourself: use the ready-made Wire object.

instance.summary: The I2C bus on pins A4 (SDA) and A5 (SCL). Call Wire.begin() in setup() first.

begin.summary: Starts the I2C bus. Without an address the board is the controller; with an address it joins as a peripheral.

params.address: 7-bit address (8 to 119) to answer to when acting as a peripheral.

end.summary: Stops the I2C bus and frees pins A4 and A5.

setClock.summary: Changes the I2C clock speed. The default is 100000 Hz.

params.clock: Clock speed in hertz, usually 100000 (standard) or 400000 (fast mode).

setWireTimeout.summary: Sets a time limit so a stuck I2C bus cannot freeze your sketch forever.

params.timeout: Time limit in microseconds (default 25000); 0 turns the timeout off.
params.reset_with_timeout: If true, the bus is reset automatically when the time limit is hit.

getWireTimeoutFlag.summary: Checks whether a timeout happened since the flag was last cleared.

beginTransmission.summary: Starts a message to a peripheral. Queue bytes with write(), then send them with endTransmission().

params.address: 7-bit address of the device, for example 0x3C or 0x68.

endTransmission.summary: Sends the bytes queued since beginTransmission() and ends the message.

params.sendStop: true (default) releases the bus; false keeps it for a following request.

endTransmission.returns: 0 on success, 1 data too long, 2 address not acknowledged, 3 data not acknowledged, 4 other error, 5 timeout.

requestFrom.summary: Asks a peripheral for bytes. Read them afterwards with available() and read().

params.quantity: Number of bytes to request (up to 32).
params.sendStop: true (default) releases the bus after the request.
params.iaddress: Internal register address to read from inside the device.
params.isize: Size of the register address in bytes (0 to 4).

onReceive.summary: Sets a function to run when this board, as a peripheral, receives data from the controller.

params.handler: Function taking the number of bytes received, for example void receiveEvent(int numBytes).

onRequest.summary: Sets a function to run when the controller asks this peripheral for data. Answer with write() inside it.

params.handler: Function with no parameters, for example void requestEvent().

BUFFER_LENGTH.summary: Size of the I2C buffer: at most 32 bytes per transmission or request.

VL53L0X.summary: Creates a VL53L0X sensor object. Call Wire.begin() and then init() in setup().

init.summary: Sets up the sensor with default settings.

params.io_2v8: true (default) for 2.8 V I/O, which most breakout boards use.

init.returns: true if the sensor was found and set up.

setTimeout.summary: Sets how long a reading may take before giving up, so the sketch never hangs.

params.timeout: Timeout in milliseconds; 0 means wait forever.

timeoutOccurred.summary: Checks whether a reading timed out since the last call.

startContinuous.summary: Starts measuring over and over, so readRangeContinuousMillimeters() can be called.

params.period_ms: Time between measurements in milliseconds; 0 (default) measures as fast as possible.

readRangeContinuousMillimeters.summary: Gets the latest distance in continuous mode, waiting for it if needed.
readRangeContinuousMillimeters.returns: Distance in millimetres; about 8190 or more means nothing in range, 65535 means timeout.

readRangeSingleMillimeters.summary: Takes one distance measurement and waits for the result.
readRangeSingleMillimeters.returns: Distance in millimetres; about 8190 or more means nothing in range, 65535 means timeout.

setAddress.summary: Gives the sensor a new I2C address, so several sensors can share one bus. The address resets at power-off.

getAddress.summary: Gets the I2C address in use.

setBus.summary: Chooses which I2C bus the sensor is on.

getBus.summary: Gets the I2C bus the sensor uses.

setSignalRateLimit.summary: Sets the weakest return signal accepted. Lower values reach farther but give less accurate readings.

params.limit_Mcps: Limit in mega counts per second, default 0.25; try 0.1 for long range.

setSignalRateLimit.returns: true if the value was valid.

getSignalRateLimit.returns: Limit in mega counts per second.

setMeasurementTimingBudget.summary: Sets how long one measurement may take. Longer budgets give more accurate readings.

params.budget_us: Time in microseconds, at least 20000; default about 33000, 200000 for high accuracy.

setMeasurementTimingBudget.returns: true if the value was valid.

setVcselPulsePeriod.summary: Sets the laser pulse period. Longer periods help reach farther (advanced).

params.period_pclks: Period in clocks: 12 to 18 for pre-range, 8 to 14 for final range (even numbers only).

setVcselPulsePeriod.returns: true if the value was valid.

writeReg.summary: Writes one byte to a sensor register (low level).

writeReg16Bit.summary: Writes a 16-bit value to a sensor register (low level).

writeReg32Bit.summary: Writes a 32-bit value to a sensor register (low level).

readReg.summary: Reads one byte from a sensor register (low level).

readReg16Bit.summary: Reads a 16-bit value from a sensor register (low level).

readReg32Bit.summary: Reads a 32-bit value from a sensor register (low level).

writeMulti.summary: Writes several bytes starting at a register (low level).

readMulti.summary: Reads several bytes starting at a register (low level).

vcselPeriodType.summary: Which laser pulse period to set: the pre-range or the final-range phase of a measurement. Write as VL53L0X::VcselPeriodPreRange.
